analyst.text: The United Nations should draw on existing reporting to assess how climate impacts compound risks in specific situations on the Security Council’s agenda, while climate policy, finance and technology transfer remain within established, inclusive climate processes.
analyst.reason: This gives the United Kingdom and France a way to bring climate evidence into Council deliberations. Using existing reports and tying assessments to specific situations addresses India’s objections to a separate climate–security track and to shifting climate decisions away from inclusive forums.
